archetype: Pastel & Soft Cartoon Brutalism (Springfield Sky & Simpsons Yellow)
emotional_tone: Playful, Nostalgic, Astonishing, Cartoonish, High-Legibility Pop
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Springfield intro sky aesthetics combined with bold cartoon brutalism, thick wobbly/chunky black borders, and playful comic cards.
Content is King & High Contrast Legibility: Big, ultra-readable typography, minimal copy clutter, bold statistical callouts, zero text-density fatigue.
Zero Dark Navy CRT: Full transformation from dark VHS mode to vibrant sunny blue sky, Simpsons yellow (#FFD90F), and bright candy accent colors.
Interactive Timeline Clarity: Seamless sorting, category filtering, and visual gap badges (e.g., '16 Years Early') for 24 real documented predictions.

visual_enhancers.clouds_background: Animated floating fluffy SVG clouds over a blue sky gradient (`from-[#7DD3FC] via-[#38BDF8] to-[#0284C7]`) with customizable speed and subtle drift.
visual_enhancers.cartoon_halftone_dots: Subtle yellow/blue radial dot pattern in background section transitions (`background-image: radial-gradient(#000000 10%, transparent 11%)`).
visual_enhancers.speech_bubble_badge: Relative position container with a small triangular SVG beak pointing toward the gap marker or episode tag.
visual_enhancers.springfield_hills_footer: Layered SVG green hills vector background above footer with bright yellow text.

components_structure.HeaderNav: Includes Springfield-styled logo title 'ALREADY AIRED', quick prediction count pill, theme music toggle icon, and direct scroll navigation.
components_structure.HeroSection: Bright cloud sky background, massive 3D-styled yellow title 'ALREADY AIRED', tag line '24 Times The Simpsons Predicted The Future', and key statistics ticker bar.
components_structure.StatsBar: Cartoon stat widgets: Total Predictions (24), Average Gap (12.4 Years), Longest Gap (29 Years - S02E18), Top Category (Tech & Politics).
components_structure.FilterBar: Category selector chips ('All', 'Tech', 'Politics', 'Science', 'Sports', 'Culture', 'Business'), Search bar with thick wobbly black outline, and Sort Toggle ('Chronological Came True' vs 'Aired Date' vs 'Gap Length').
components_structure.PredictionTimeline: Vertical central spine on desktop (cards alternating left/right) and left spine on mobile. Each node features a yellow donut bullet point with thick black outline.
components_structure.PredictionCard: Card displaying Episode Code (e.g. S11E17), Episode Title, Year Aired (1998), Year Came True (2016), Gap pill ('18 Years Early'), Category tag, Bold headline, Concise summary, and detail expand modal button.
components_structure.DetailModal: Thick black outline modal popping up with high-contrast information, episode trivia, real-life outcome comparison, and sharing clip feature.
components_structure.Footer: Fan site legal disclaimer banner ('Fan creation. Not affiliated with Fox, Disney, or The Simpsons.'), SVG cloud horizon, and back-to-top button.

predictions_dataset.headline: Donald Trump Becomes President
predictions_dataset.detail: Lisa becomes president after Donald Trump leaves office, leaving the country broke. Trump officially took office 16 years later.

predictions_dataset.headline: Smartwatches & Voice Calling
predictions_dataset.detail: Hugh Parkfield uses a wristwatch device to make phone calls and talk to his watch, predicting the Apple Watch nearly two decades early.

predictions_dataset.headline: Faulty Electronic Voting Machines
predictions_dataset.detail: Homer tries to vote for Barack Obama, but the voting machine flips his vote to John McCain. In 2012, Pennsylvania voting machines did exactly that.

predictions_dataset.headline: Mass of the Higgs Boson Particle
predictions_dataset.detail: Homer writes an equation on a chalkboard that accurately predicted the mass of the God particle (Higgs Boson) 14 years before CERN discovered it.

predictions_dataset.episode_title: When You Dish Upon a Star
predictions_dataset.headline: Disney Acquires 20th Century Fox
predictions_dataset.detail: A sign outside 20th Century Fox studios shows 'A Division of Walt Disney Co.'. Disney acquired 21st Century Fox for $71.3B in 2017.

predictions_dataset.headline: Autocorrect Failures ('Beat Up Martin')
predictions_dataset.detail: Kearney writes 'Beat up Martin' on an Apple Newton, which autocorrects to 'Eat up Martha'. Apple engineers famously used this scene as motivation while building the iPhone keyboard.

predictions_dataset.headline: Video Calling on Rotary Screens
predictions_dataset.detail: Lisa communicates with Marge via a screen mounted on a phone unit, predicting FaceTime and Skype video conferencing.

predictions_dataset.headline: White Tiger Attack on Performers
predictions_dataset.detail: Gunter & Ernst are attacked by their white tiger in Mr. Burns' casino. Ten years later, Roy Horn of Siegfried & Roy was tragically attacked on stage by a white tiger.

predictions_dataset.headline: Horse Meat in School Lunches
predictions_dataset.detail: Lunchlady Doris pours 'assorted horse parts' into school lunches. In 2013, a major European scandal broke out involving horse meat labeled as beef.

predictions_dataset.episode_title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
predictions_dataset.headline: FIFA Corruption & World Cup Arrests
predictions_dataset.detail: The World Football Federation executive is arrested for corruption in Springfield. Just one year later, FIFA officials were arrested by federal agents in Zurich.

predictions_dataset.headline: Washington & Dallas Super Bowl Wins
predictions_dataset.detail: Lisa accurately predicted the Washington Redskins winning Super Bowl XXVI, and when re-dubbed for later years, correctly predicted the Cowboys winning XXVII and XXVIII.

predictions_dataset.headline: Virtual Yard Work & VR Farming
predictions_dataset.detail: Kids lining up to play 'Yard Work Simulator' in VR, predicting the obsession with casual farming games like FarmVille and Job Simulator.

predictions_dataset.headline: Ebola Virus Book & Outbreak
predictions_dataset.detail: Marge holds a book titled 'Curious George and the Ebola Virus'. The major international West African Ebola outbreak occurred in 2014.

predictions_dataset.headline: The Shard Building in London
predictions_dataset.detail: When Lisa visits London, a skyscraper identical in design and location to The Shard is visible near Tower Bridge—14 years before construction even began.

predictions_dataset.episode_title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
predictions_dataset.headline: Blinky the Three-Eyed Mutant Fish
predictions_dataset.detail: Bart catches a three-eyed fish named Blinky near the nuclear power plant. Fishermen in Argentina caught a real three-eyed wolf fish near a nuclear plant in 2011.

predictions_dataset.headline: Ringo Starr Replies to Decades-Old Fan Mail
predictions_dataset.detail: Ringo Starr responds to Marge's fan mail 50 years later. In 2013, Paul McCartney actually replied to two fans who sent fan mail 50 years prior.

predictions_dataset.headline: Virtual Reality Eating & Metaverse
predictions_dataset.detail: Homer and Marge eat digital food using VR headsets and feeding tubes, predicting modern VR headsets and metaverse culinary experiences.

predictions_dataset.headline: Protests Over Michelangelo's David Nudity
predictions_dataset.detail: Springfield residents protest against the nude David statue. In 2016, Russian campaigners held a vote on whether to clothe a replica of David in St. Petersburg.

predictions_dataset.headline: Headset Bumping & Spatial Computing
predictions_dataset.detail: Mr. Burns hires Homer's family to act as his VR family, showing people walking into lampposts while wearing headsets—mirroring 2024 Vision Pro viral videos.

predictions_dataset.headline: Deep Sea Submersible Oxygen Emergency
predictions_dataset.detail: Homer travels deep underwater in a sub to find lost treasure and runs out of oxygen trapped in coral. In 2023, the Titan sub tragedy captured worldwide attention.

predictions_dataset.headline: Angular Car Design 'The Homer'
predictions_dataset.detail: Homer designs a bizarre, angular car with custom specs that bankrupts his brother. Tech fans drew immediate comparisons when Tesla unveiled the angular Cybertruck.

predictions_dataset.headline: Stealing Restaurant Cooking Oil / Grease
predictions_dataset.detail: Homer and Bart steal grease from school kitchens to sell for profit. A decade later, rising biofuel prices led to a real-world crime wave of restaurant grease thefts.

predictions_dataset.episode_title: The Man Who Came to Be Dinner
predictions_dataset.headline: Mathematical Geometry In Animation
predictions_dataset.detail: Show writers included complex mathematical equations for topology and string theory that were later published in academic physics journals.

predictions_dataset.headline: Lady Gaga Harness Aerial Performance
predictions_dataset.detail: Lady Gaga flies into a stadium suspended by cables in a bedazzled outfit. Five years later, her actual Super Bowl LI halftime show featured the exact same aerial entrance.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: AA/AAA compliant: Text is solid black (#0F172A) on high-contrast yellow (#FFD90F), white (#FFFFFF), or soft pastels.
accessibility.motion_reduction: Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling cloud animation and card lift effects.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, chips, card expanders, search inputs, modal triggers) MUST include descriptive `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='prediction-card-trump-presidency', data-testid='category-chip-politics').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Completely strip all dark navy CRT VHS styles from App.css and index.css.
2. Inject the Google Fonts URL for 'Luckiest Guy', 'Fredoka', and 'Nunito' into index.html or index.css.
3. Set the HTML/body background to Springfield sky blue gradient (#38BDF8) with floating CSS/SVG clouds.
4. Use thick wobbly cartoon borders (border-4 border-black) and hard drop shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000] or shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#000]) for cards, buttons, and badges.
5. Render a single-page timeline containing all 24 predictions provided in the dataset with instant category filter chips and instant search.
6. Keep font sizes large (headings 3xl-6xl, body lg-xl, badges bold base) to satisfy the user's high legibility request.
7. Include a fan disclaimer footer at the bottom ('Fan site. Not affiliated with Fox, Disney, or The Simpsons').
8. Ensure every key UI component has data-testid attributes for reliable testing.
